keyFindings.description: CALL_MODE (line 124) admits any inputs.<declared input> == / != '<literal>' as neutral, but only a term true for an unset input (== '' or != '<non-empty>') cannot narrow. Reproduced at this head with the test file's own fixture and call_modes helpers: build job gated on inputs.mode == 'attest' -> exit 0, inputs.mode != '' -> exit 0, if: false -> exit 1. Such a gate turns the image build off on every pull_request, workflow_dispatch and unset-input call, and the required lint check passes. Fix: admit only terms true when the input is unset; add refusal cases.
